name: yurei-panel
description: Yurei Project — panel communautaire (Next.js + NestJS + Prisma + Redis)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build:shared && npm run prisma:generate
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @yurei/api" "npm run dev -w @yurei/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @yurei/api && npm run build -w @yurei/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run start -w @yurei/api" "npm run start -w @yurei/web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @yurei/api && npm run lint -w @yurei/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @yurei/shared && npm run typecheck -w @yurei/api && npm run typecheck -w @yurei/web
